summary: EVAVO Godot Game Test Lab independently inspects, validates, executes and captures evidence from external Godot projects; provisions checksum-verified engines; audits exact Godot web export descriptors, asset identities and threaded isolation evidence; runs exact-head plural localization, stable-ID application-bundle admission, native authored, concurrent multiplayer, attended multiplayer, bot and no-network QA; analyses retained media; and compiles exact asset and animation evidence. It may write managed caches, transient ignored probe material and governed evidence outside target source authority, but does not repair, edit, publish or grant deployment authority over target repositories.

capabilities.title: Expose privacy-safe Automated Testing readiness
capabilities.description: Report compatible Godot and specialist readiness without selecting, executing, mutating or provisioning a target project and without exposing executable paths.
requires: Godot Game Test Lab source checkout

capabilities.title: Provision governed Godot engines
capabilities.description: Select, download or reuse official Godot editor and export-template archives under governed policy, verify checksums and retain managed receipts outside target repositories.
requires: Official godotengine/godot-builds source or approved offline source
Managed engine root distinct from target repository

capabilities.title: Inspect and audit Godot projects
capabilities.description: Inspect one allowed project and run bounded scene, resource, path, Git, export and asset integrity checks without executing or modifying it.

capabilities.title: Audit exact Godot web export bundles
capabilities.description: Inspect one bounded Godot web export directory and schemaVersion 2 export descriptor, verify safe local asset references, SHA-256 and byte-size identities, required JS/WASM/PCK coverage, threaded isolation intent or retained COOP/COEP evidence, and signature-envelope structure without executing a browser or granting publication authority.
requires: Bounded local Godot web export root
schemaVersion 2 export.json descriptor inside the export root
Retained COOP/COEP header evidence when threaded isolation is not descriptor-provided
Browser execution and publication authority remain downstream

capabilities.title: Run authoritative Godot validation
capabilities.description: Run exact-source integrity, optional .NET build, Godot import, bounded runtime, recording and export evidence while keeping target repair and publication outside Test Lab authority.
requires: Downstream authority for repair or publication

capabilities.title: Validate exact-head Godot plural localization runtime
capabilities.description: Verify one fingerprinted plural artifact against an exact clean target head, run authoritative import and reviewed integer lookup probes, remove transient material and prove target source remained unchanged.
requires: Exact clean target Git head with supported github.com origin
Compatible Godot editor and .NET SDK when required

capabilities.title: Admit exact stable-ID application bundles
capabilities.description: Independently verify a fingerprinted Localization Manager stable-ID application bundle against one exact clean Godot repository head, including current and proposed scene bytes, stable-key assignments, source-catalog bytes, provenance and post-run non-mutation. It does not apply files, execute Godot, commit, push, release or publish.
requires: Exact clean target Git head with supported github.com origin
Exact current, proposed and source-catalog byte identities
Separate product-owned authority for later application or commit

capabilities.title: Run exact-SHA native authored QA
capabilities.description: Run target-authored native Windows journeys against exact Lab and target SHAs, retaining bounded synchronized evidence outside both repositories.
requires: Interactive Windows session for authoritative visual evidence

capabilities.title: Run and independently attest exact-SHA concurrent multiplayer QA
capabilities.description: Run two to eight reviewed multiplayer roles concurrently under one guarded desktop lease with isolated runtime homes, bounded evidence and final mutation verification, then optionally rehash that completed run into a same-session operator-attended receipt without converting attendance into human approval.
requires: Reviewed multiplayer profile with 2 to 8 roles
Completed passed multiplayer run for attended receipt
Same-session operator attestation for attended receipt

capabilities.title: Run deterministic bot QA
capabilities.description: Execute bounded deterministic fresh-process bot journeys across supported input paths while retaining replay, state and media evidence without claiming complete state coverage.

capabilities.title: Run isolated Linux Godot QA
capabilities.description: Prepare an ephemeral bounded copy and run Linux Godot validation under a governed no-network sandbox while keeping the target outside repair and publication authority.

capabilities.title: Analyse retained gameplay media
capabilities.description: Extract and analyse synchronized gameplay audio and video with governed FFmpeg policy while keeping human mix and visual judgment separate.

capabilities.title: Admit exact installed game-asset deliveries
capabilities.description: Bind an exact game head, delivery bundle, storage admission, installed bytes and optional native evidence into create-only asset-delivery evidence.
requires: Optional native evidence for full pass

capabilities.title: Admit Brass visual-animation evidence
capabilities.description: Verify exact candidate and frame bytes, SpriteFrames references, Art Studio evaluations and Godot engine evidence while retaining creative and publication approvals as false.
requires: Passed Godot import or render evidence

capabilities.title: Run exact-byte rig-motion acceptance v4.1
capabilities.description: Run an isolated hash-bound Godot rig-motion probe, require measurable motion and write create-only evidence for named human review.
requires: Named human review after technical acceptance

topics: Godot web export integrity and threaded isolation evidence
authored, multiplayer, attended multiplayer and bot QA
